defeats.how: The synopsis only says Hawkeye captured Gyrich as an "intruder" at the mansion; the Vision later freed him.
The Vision used his solar beams to dehydrate Tyrak, letting the heroes beat him.
defeats.evidence: The heroes beat Tyrak when Vision uses his solar beams to dehydrate him

defeats.how: The synopsis only shows the unseen villain holding the kidnapped Avengers in suspended animation tubes; it does not say how they were taken.
defeats.evidence: This unseen villain is shown to have all the kidnapped Avengers (as well as Moondragon, who hadn't been shown to be kidnapped) in suspended animation tubes
